messages:
nate: Heads-up — saw a weird spike in tenant fallback traffic after the latest client release (v2.3.0). Looks like clients are toggling between v1/v2 on retry, causing duplicate quota burns.

maggie: ugh, saw that too. route_mismatch_rate jumped ~6x at 12:14 UTC. linked to header TTL changes?

nate: yeah, clients now send `X-Client-Version: v2;ttl=5m` but some proxies rewrite TTL -> 0 on retry. fallback picks v1 and then client retries, ends up back on v2. loop.

jordan: can you paste the exact header example?

nate: here: `X-Client-Version: v2;ttl=300` then on our edge we sometimes rewrite to `X-Client-Version: v2;ttl=0` on 503 retry path.

sam: that explains the loops. When TTL=0 our routing policy treats request as unpinned and will autoswitch based on quota pressure -> sends to v1 variant. client retry uses new header and flips back.

emma: started alerting customers for unexpected usage. we need a short-term mitigation and a safer rollout path.

maggie: mitigation idea: add a server-side "grace-anchor" that pins route for X seconds after first successful routing decision regardless of incoming TTL. default 2m. that prevents immediate flip on retry storm.

nate: +1. Also propose activity sampling to avoid pinning forever: pin only if tenant fallthroughs > 0 for that minute OR route_mismatch_rate > 1%. otherwise no change.

jordan: console UX: add a per-tenant toggle and a preview that shows how many requests would have been pinned historically. otherwise support teams will be nervous.

sam: operationally we should also add a throttle that caps "rollback" reroutes to N/minute per-tenant to reduce quota burn. maybe default 10/min.

emma: agree. need to update runbook with exact metrics and rollback steps. who will own rollout?

maggie: i'll own rollout/prod deploy, sam can own the quota-throttle impl, nate will add telemetry signals + dashboard. jordan can wire the console toggle + preview.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: compat-grace-anchor v1.0 -> prod-canary (2 hosts) by maggie at 2025-03-11T13:00:00Z

maggie: quick config sketch for the feature (for prod-canary):

```yaml
compat_grace_anchor:
  enabled: true
  default_anchor_seconds: 120
  pin_if_fallthroughs_min: 1
  route_mismatch_threshold_pct: 1.0
  rollback_reroute_cap_per_min: 10
  sampling_rate: 0.2  # apply to 20% of tenants for canary
```

nate: telemetry to add: `compat_grace_pin_rate`, `compat_grace_effectiveness` (% reduced flips), `rollback_reroute_cap_hits`, and per-tenant `quota_burn_delta`. We'll need chart panels and an alert if quota_burn_delta > 50% baseline for more than 2m.

sam: implemented prototype locally. API for throttle looks like: `POST /internal/routing/throttle?tenant_id=...&limit=10` then middleware will decrement token bucket.

jordan: console wire: preview query will run a historical pass and return a sample count of pinned requests and estimated token savings. show a small confidence interval.

emma: runbook: if pinned traffic causes higher latency fallback, we can toggle sampling_rate->0 and disable anchor per-tenant. also rollback path: set sampling to 0, disable feature, and trigger tenant-specific throttles.

maggie: launching prod-canary at 13:00. will monitor the new charts. Nate — can you add the panels and a temporary dashboard link in #incidents?

nate: on it. will post link + first 30m summary.

emma: thanks team. big win if this prevents the v1/v2 flip loop during client rollouts.

sam: one more note — let's add a small log line when we apply grace pin: `compat_grace=pin tenant=... reason=route_mismatch sample=true/false` so we can audit.

maggie: agreed. keep logs low volume (sampled).

deploy-bot: deployment started: compat-grace-anchor v1.0 -> prod-canary (2 hosts)

emma: tracking thread here for postmortem and internal comms. will draft a short status blurb for impacted customers if needed.

maggie: thanks all. will update in 15m.
